name: assembly-programming
description: Assembly Programming: instruction-level reference for x86-64, AArch64, and RISC-V — the machine model, calling conventions and ABIs, assemblers and toolchains, reading disassembly, performance engineering, SIMD/vector (SSE/AVX/AVX-512, NEON/SVE2/SME, RVV), systems and constant-time cryptographic assembly, inline assembly and intrinsics, and debugging/verification.
